title: Trailora
subtitle: Production Full-Stack Travel Booking Platform
description: As the sole developer, I engineered, built, and deployed Trailora end-to-end as a live travel-booking platform, spanning a responsive React frontend, Node.js/Express REST API, MongoDB Atlas, authentication and authorization, Stripe payments, AWS infrastructure, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI/CD.
highlights: Responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile product experience with tour discovery, search, filtering, maps, authentication, bookings, reviews, and downloadable invoices.
REST APIs and MongoDB workflows for tours, users, reviews, and bookings with JWT/cookie authentication, role-based authorization, and verified Stripe webhooks.
Production delivery through AWS, Docker, Nginx, and GitHub Actions, including S3/CloudFront frontend deployment and commit-SHA backend releases to EC2.

title: usePopcorn
subtitle: React Movie Discovery & Rating Application
description: A responsive React application implemented from scratch with reusable custom hooks, OMDb API integration, abortable asynchronous requests, persistent localStorage state, keyboard interactions, and reusable rating and movie components.

title: React Quiz
subtitle: Timed React Quiz Application
description: A responsive React quiz application implemented from scratch with useReducer-driven state management, asynchronous question loading, timed quiz flow, scoring, progress tracking, answer feedback, and restart functionality.
